new_or_changed_source_derived_reviews.positive: Dog with an eligible listed cancer, >3-month prognosis, required concurrent cancer-directed care and site-specific screening.
new_or_changed_source_derived_reviews.negative: Concurrent immunosuppression, immune-mediated disease, another active cancer or disallowed concurrent trial/immunotherapy.
new_or_changed_source_derived_reviews.unknown: Site-specific metastatic burden, exception criteria and final prognosis require treating oncologist prescreening.
